label: GPU Parallelism
definition: Thousands of smaller CUDA cores optimized for massively parallel throughput — not per-core speed

label: CUDA Warp / SIMT
definition: 32 threads (1 warp) execute the same instruction simultaneously under SIMT

label: Tensor Cores
definition: Specialized hardware units for mixed-precision matrix multiply-accumulate in one cycle

label: Mixed Precision Training
definition: FP32 master weights, compute in FP16/BF16, accumulate gradients in FP32

label: FP16 vs BF16
definition: BF16 = 8 exponent bits (same as FP32, same dynamic range, less mantissa); FP16 = 5 exponent bits (narrower range, needs loss scaling)

label: FP8 / Transformer Engine
definition: 8-bit float training introduced in Hopper (H100); Transformer Engine auto-selects FP8/BF16 per layer

label: TensorRT
definition: Inference OPTIMIZATION SDK: layer fusion, quantization, kernel auto-tuning → serialized .engine file per GPU

label: Triton Inference Server
definition: Inference SERVING platform: multi-framework (TensorRT/PyTorch/ONNX), HTTP/gRPC API, dynamic batching

label: MIG — Multi-Instance GPU
definition: Hardware GPU partitioning: dedicated SMs + HBM slice + L2 per instance; full fault AND memory isolation; A100/H100 only; max 7 instances

label: MPS — Multi-Process Service
definition: Software GPU sharing: multiple CUDA processes share one context; NO memory isolation; NO fault isolation; Pascal+

label: NVLink
definition: Intra-node GPU-to-GPU interconnect; NVLink 3.0 = 600 GB/s (A100); NVLink 4.0 = 900 GB/s (H100)

label: NVSwitch
definition: Switch chip enabling ALL-TO-ALL NVLink between all 8 GPUs in a DGX at full bandwidth simultaneously

label: InfiniBand (HDR/NDR)
definition: Inter-node RDMA-native interconnect; HDR = 200 Gb/s; NDR = 400 Gb/s; sub-microsecond latency

label: GPUDirect RDMA
definition: NIC ↔ GPU HBM direct DMA, bypassing CPU and host DRAM entirely

label: SHARP (In-Network AllReduce)
definition: MPI AllReduce performed INSIDE InfiniBand switch ASICs — not at compute endpoints

label: BlueField DPU
definition: SmartNIC with ARM cores that offloads networking, storage, and security FROM the host CPU

label: DGX H100 System
definition: 8× H100 SXM5 + 4× NVSwitch + 8× ConnectX-7 NDR InfiniBand NICs; TDP ~10.2 kW

label: DCGM
definition: Cluster-wide GPU health monitoring: utilization, temperature, power, ECC errors, NVLink errors; integrates with Prometheus/Grafana

label: nvidia-smi
definition: Single GPU status CLI — NOT for cluster-scale monitoring

label: Slurm
definition: HPC batch job scheduler: partitions, job queues, fairshare, GRES for GPU allocation (`--gres=gpu:8`)

label: Kubernetes + GPU Operator
definition: Container orchestration for inference/microservices; GPU Operator automates driver+plugin+DCGM stack

label: NVIDIA Base Command Platform
definition: AI training platform LAYER ON TOP of Slurm/K8s: job orchestration, data management, NGC integration, multi-tenant cluster

label: BMC — Baseboard Management Controller
definition: Embedded hardware controller: out-of-band power/reset, sensor monitoring, serial console — OS-independent
